Name: FarmInfoOverlay
Author: glopmtsyt
Description:
[heading]📋 Description[/heading]
Transform your Stardew Valley experience with a clean and immersive overlay that shows real-time information directly on your farm objects and storage. No more opening dozens of chests or guessing machine timers — everything you need is visible instantly.
[heading]✨ Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]📦 Display item counts directly above chests [/*]
[*]⏱️ Real-time machine timers [/*]
[*]🌾 Visual farm management without opening menus [/*]
[*]🎨 Seamless UI that matches Stardew Valley’s style [/*]
[*]⚡ Lightweight and performance friendly [/*]
[*]🔄 Updates automatically while you play[/*]
[/list][heading]🎮 Controls[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]H (default)[/b] — Toggle the overlay on/off[/*]
[/list]You can change the keybind in the configuration file.


[b]✨ REPOSITORIE[/b]

[/url][i]Don't forget to leave your star![/i]  :-D
